quotations.old_english: Se fullcáflíce bræd of ðæm beorne blódigne gár
quotations.english: he very eagerly plucked the bloody dart from the chief

source_text: full-cáflíce; adv. Full quickly, very eagerly; velociss&i-short;me :-- Se fullcáflíce bræd of ðæm beorne blódigne gár he very eagerly plucked the bloody dart from the chief, Byrht. Th. 136, 19; By. 153.
